ui_bugs.issue: ESC key does not close the modal (only the X button does). Minor UX nit - tests can work around by clicking X. Same may affect OpDetailModal navigation if user tries to use ESC then immediately click sidebar.

action_items: (Optional) Add ESC key handler to close modals (CotizadorPage preview modal, OpDetailModal) for better UX consistency.

(Optional, code review) server.py is now ~1505 lines (was 975 in V1). Splitting routers (routers/cotizaciones.py, routers/actividades.py, routers/documentos.py, services/pdf.py, services/alerts.py) is becoming necessary before adding more features.
(Optional) test_alerta endpoint allows duplicate test alerts piling up - may want to dedupe or limit to last N for the mock case. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1505 lines with V2 endpoints inline; should be split into routers/services modules.

/api/oportunidades/{oid}/convertir-obra: stores _op_id in DB doc and pops before returning - good. But the auto-actividad insertion is not transactional with the obra insert; if obra insert succeeds but actividad insert fails, you get a silent inconsistency. Consider try/except around the actividad insert and a warning log, or accept it as best-effort.
/api/radar/{rid}/importar: stores _from_radar in op doc and pops _id but does NOT pop _from_radar before returning - the field leaks into the response. Minor.

/api/actividades and /api/documentos lack role guards: any authenticated user (including operaciones) can read/create/delete any user's actividades or documentos. Consider restricting delete to owner or director.
DocumentoIn.tamano_bytes has no upper bound; without a real storage layer it's harmless, but when binary upload is added, add max size enforcement.

DEYMA_ALERT_PHONE / TWILIO_* vars correctly default to empty string and TWILIO_ENABLED resolves to False - mock path works as designed. When user adds keys later, ensure phone format validation (E.164) is added in send_whatsapp before the live call.
_build_cotizacion_pdf runs via asyncio.to_thread - good. ReportLab is sync. Verified PDF >2KB with %PDF magic bytes and correct content-disposition filename.
/api/alertas/test endpoint creates an alert every call with score=90 and is rate-limit-free; in dev this is fine but should probably warn or rate-limit in prod.
Frontend modals (CotizadorPage preview, OpDetailModal) do not bind Escape key handler - users have to click the X.
